spec.title: Homelab runners
spec.description: ARC scale sets on the homelab cluster (runs-on: homelab) and the daddy host their builds run on.

spec.title: Waiting jobs
spec.description: Jobs GitHub assigned to a homelab scale set that no runner has picked up yet. HomelabRunnerJobsPending fires after 10 minutes above zero.

spec.title: Runner pods
spec.description: Pods counted against the `runners` ResourceQuota (hard limit 4, shared by all repositories).

spec.title: Listeners
spec.description: Listener pods the ARC controller reports running, one per repository. Without its listener a repository's jobs stay queued.

spec.title: Jobs completed
spec.description: Over the selected time range.

spec.title: Jobs not succeeded
spec.description: Failed or cancelled jobs over the selected time range.

spec.title: Job timeline
spec.description: One row per workflow job. Blue: a runner holds the job (EphemeralRunner objects through kube-state-metrics, sampled every 20 s). Green or red: the job finished in that step, from the listener's counters, so jobs shorter than a sample still show up.

spec.expr: max by (repository, job_name) (label_replace(arc_ephemeralrunner_job_info{repository=~"$repository", job_display_name!=""}, "job_name", "$1", "job_display_name", "(.+)") or label_set((sum by (repository, job_name) (increase(gha_completed_jobs_total{repository=~"$repository", job_result="succeeded"}[$__interval])) > 0) * 0 + 2, "src", "ok") or label_set((sum by (repository, job_name) (increase(gha_completed_jobs_total{repository=~"$repository", job_result!="succeeded"}[$__interval])) > 0) * 0 + 3, "src", "failed"))

spec.title: Job runs
spec.description: Runs seen in the time range, newest first. Start and duration come from the 20 s samples of the EphemeralRunner, so both are off by up to that much. The run id opens the run on GitHub.

spec.expr: max by (organization, repository, workflow, job_display_name, workflow_run_id, ephemeralrunner) (label_replace(tfirst_over_time(arc_ephemeralrunner_job_info{repository=~"$repository", job_display_name!=""}[$__range]), "workflow", "$1", "workflow_ref", "[^@]*/([^/@]+)@.*")) * 1000

max by (organization, repository, workflow, job_display_name, workflow_run_id, ephemeralrunner) (label_replace(tlast_over_time(arc_ephemeralrunner_job_info{repository=~"$repository", job_display_name!=""}[$__range]) - tfirst_over_time(arc_ephemeralrunner_job_info{repository=~"$repository", job_display_name!=""}[$__range]), "workflow", "$1", "workflow_ref", "[^@]*/([^/@]+)@.*"))

spec.title: Jobs completed
spec.description: Jobs finished per bar. The bar width follows the time range: about 50 bars, at least a minute each.

spec.title: Queue time
spec.description: From GitHub assigning a job to the runner starting it: pod scheduling, image pull and runner registration. Each point is the mean of the jobs that started in that interval, exact rather than estimated from histogram buckets.

spec.title: Job duration
spec.description: Each point is the mean duration of the jobs with that name that finished in that interval. Logarithmic axis: jobs range from seconds to tens of minutes.

spec.expr: sum by (repository, job_name) (increase(gha_job_execution_duration_seconds_sum{repository=~"$repository"}[$__interval])) / sum by (repository, job_name) (increase(gha_job_execution_duration_seconds_count{repository=~"$repository"}[$__interval]))

spec.title: Jobs over the time range
spec.description: Per workflow job. Runner time is the sum of all runs' durations.

spec.expr: round(sum by (repository, job_name) (increase(gha_completed_jobs_total{repository=~"$repository", job_result!="succeeded"}[$__range]))) or 0 * sum by (repository, job_name) (gha_completed_jobs_total{repository=~"$repository"})

sum by (repository, job_name) (increase(gha_job_startup_duration_seconds_sum{repository=~"$repository"}[$__range])) / sum by (repository, job_name) (increase(gha_job_startup_duration_seconds_count{repository=~"$repository"}[$__range]))

sum by (repository, job_name) (increase(gha_job_execution_duration_seconds_sum{repository=~"$repository"}[$__range])) / sum by (repository, job_name) (increase(gha_job_execution_duration_seconds_count{repository=~"$repository"}[$__range]))

spec.title: Jobs by repository
spec.description: Running jobs stacked per repository, with jobs waiting for a runner on top; `total` is every assigned job.

spec.title: Runners
spec.description: Busy and idle runners (as GitHub sees them) and runner pods that are still pending or failed, stacked. Desired comes from the listeners; max is the scale sets' ceiling.

spec.title: Runner pod CPU
spec.description: Request 1 core, no CPU limit. Heavy builds run on daddy, not here.

spec.title: Runner pod memory
spec.description: Request 2 GiB, limit 6 GiB.

spec.title: Services
spec.description: systemd state on daddy: nix-daemon serves the CI's ssh-ng store (NIX_CI_STORE), buildkit the runners' buildx remote driver, kasha the LAN binary cache. Jellyfin shares the box.

spec.title: Free space
spec.description: The SSD root holds the Nix store and BuildKit's cache. BuildKit garbage-collects to keep 50 GB free (dashed line) and caps its cache at 100 GB; nix-gc runs on a timer.

spec.title: Cache lookups (kasha)
spec.description: narinfo lookups against the LAN binary cache on daddy, per bar. Misses are fetched upstream.

spec.title: Cache traffic (kasha)
spec.description: NAR bytes served to clients, ingested (pushed by CI and hosts) and pulled from upstreams.

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: Busy time by mode across all cores. iowait points at the disks rather than the CPU.

spec.title: Pressure
spec.description: Pressure stall information: the share of time some task waited for the resource. This, not utilisation, shows CI builds, BuildKit and Jellyfin slowing each other down.

spec.title: Memory
spec.description: BuildKit is capped at 12 GiB (MemoryMax).

spec.title: Network
spec.description: Out is plotted below zero. enp6s0 carries the runners' Nix and BuildKit traffic, cache traffic and uploads; tailscale0 is remote access.

spec.title: Disk throughput
spec.description: Writes plotted below zero. sdb is the SSD (root, Nix store, BuildKit), sda the HDD (kasha, media).

spec.title: Disk busy
spec.description: Share of time each disk had I/O in flight. Near 100% the disk is the bottleneck.

spec.title: Why jobs wait
spec.description: Jobs assigned to a runner but not running yet, stacked by cause: runner pods pending while the namespace quota is full (pod quota full), runner pods no node has room for (no node fits; all repositories, whatever the filter), other pending runner pods, so image pull or container start (pod starting), and the rest, waiting on GitHub or the listener (other). A scale set never runs more runners than its maxRunners: jobs beyond that wait without a pod, so the line "repos at maxRunners" counts the repositories whose assigned jobs reach that cap. The pod lines cover all repositories.
